name: expert-overview
title: Expert overview
description: What needs a busy person and what the agents are doing, on one quiet page: at most three plain sentences that need them (one gesture each, a quiet Later on a question), one line per app, finished work folded, and a four-step track per app. A calm state when nothing needs them, and no counts of agent work, badges or red. Props only: the app writes every sentence, count and day; the block fetches nothing and reads no clock.
